section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section expresses the wish that the hope and desire of the Rebbe Rayatz be fulfilled, that with this Torah scroll we will go out to greet Moshiach Tzidkeinu very soon, immediately.
section.t: And may it be His will that the hope and desire of the holy Rebbe, the Rebbe Rayatz, of blessed memory, be fulfilled,
that with this Torah scroll we will go out to greet Moshiach Tzidkeinu,
